baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence 'created the human / know what his self whispers / nearer than the jugular cord.'
baseline_models.mechanism: Prior measuring and making continue as present disclosure of the self's concealed content; comparative nearness outruns even the human's own life-bearing internal connection.

activation_trace.role: Creation contributes prior measuring and forming, grounding continuity between maker and made.
Knowledge is disclosure to the knower, so concealed content is already open.
Names the hidden self-talk reached by that knowledge.
Locates whispering in inward reason, intention, and apprehension.
Supplies nearness as the opposite of distance.
Makes the comparator an internal bodily vessel or connection.
Specifies the neck's life-vein as the innermost comparative line.

changed_reading.before: A general assertion that the creator knows thoughts and is near.
changed_reading.after: Creation, inward disclosure, and nearness form one continuous relation: the human is known before hidden thought acquires distance, more immediately than by the body's own life-line.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The contact between 'whispers,' 'self,' and the anatomical cord-vein comparison.
baseline_models.mechanism: A whisper is modeled at the threshold of sound and breath, while cord and vein model bodily transmission; nearness reaches the event before it separates into psyche, sound, or physiology.

activation_trace.role: Contributes a barely audible sound or movement, placing thought near acoustic embodiment.
Contributes breath emerging from within as a bodily analogue for whispering.
Adds close involvement or contact rather than bare metric distance.
Supplies the body's connected vessels as a transmission network.
Anchors the network in the life-bearing jugular vein.

changed_reading.before: Whispering is purely mental and nearness is an abstract attribute.
changed_reading.after: The verse places knowing at the micro-threshold where inward impulse, hidden sound, breath, and circulation have not yet become separable events.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired 'we know what...' clauses join invisible outward subtraction by earth to invisible inward movement by the self; guarding makes knowledge a mode of retaining the person across both losses.

activation_trace.role: Focus knowledge discloses the self's hidden content.
The self as the person's very identity makes inward content part of what must be retained.
Repeats disclosed knowledge for what happens to bodies in earth.
Supplies bodily diminution as loss of parts that remains known.
Adds guarding and preservation to knowledge of what is lost.

structural_cues: 50:4 and 50:16 repeat first-person plural knowledge followed by a ma-clause; earth/book precede self/vein.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel syntax, material subtraction, and a guarded record; I infer an identity-preserving link between lost matter and hidden thought. A live alternative is that they are separate examples of omniscience without a retention mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns present access to private thought.
changed_reading.after: Its inward knowledge is one half of a larger retention system that holds together material and interior identity even when the body is diminished.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus supplies concealed self-talk; the next sequence supplies reception, oral ejection, guarding, and readiness. Divine knowing therefore occupies stage zero, before inward movement becomes an emitted and recordable saying.

activation_trace.role: Supplies pre-articulate hidden self-talk.
Contributes receiving speech as a downstream uptake operation.
Marks the threshold where inner content is emitted by the tongue.
Adds guarding of the now-externalized saying.
Makes the recorder present and prepared at that threshold.

structural_cues: 50:16-18 moves without interruption from self-whisper, to two receivers, to speech leaving the mouth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered verbal stages; I infer a cognitive-to-acoustic pipeline and assign direct divine knowledge temporal priority over recording. A live alternative is that reception covers deeds generally rather than a staged transition from thought to speech.

changed_reading.before: Knowing the whisper and recording speech are equivalent forms of surveillance.
changed_reading.after: The focus distinguishes immediate knowledge of intention from the later event of utterance: no spoken record is needed for the inward act to be known.

context_deltas.mechanism: The anatomical life-line is followed immediately by death and later enclosed by the claim to give life and cause death; nearness is thus prior to, rather than produced by, the circulation used as comparator.

activation_trace.role: Contributes flowing blood as bodily support of life.
Anchors the comparison in the jugular life-vein.
Immediately supplies the departure of bodily force and life.
Restates animate life as a state under divine agency.
Pairs that agency with causing life's force to depart.

structural_cues: Death follows the jugular comparison in 50:19, while 50:43 closes the arc with 'We give life and cause death.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a life-vein and the bracketing life/death claims; I infer that the giver's nearness does not depend on a functioning pulse. A live alternative confines the comparison to vivid present knowledge during life.

changed_reading.before: The jugular is simply the nearest available anatomical object.
changed_reading.after: The vein marks a biological limit that divine nearness precedes and survives; loss of pulse ends the comparator, not the relation asserted through it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hidden reverence toward mercy and a heart that repeatedly returns turn the focus's one-way disclosure into a possible inward response: the self known in secret can orient itself toward the near knower before public speech.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the inward seat of intention that can answer as well as whisper.
Activates cord as bond, security, and connection for a relational reading of nearness.
Contributes reverent fear as an inward orientation.
Places tenderness and mercy at the other pole of that orientation.
Keeps the response hidden from sight, matching the focus's concealed interior.
Names the heart as the responding inward center.
Adds repeated return, giving the inward relation a direction back.

structural_cues: 50:33 recombines hiddenness, an inward organ, and return under the divine name of mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden reverence, mercy, and a returning heart; I infer reciprocity with the focus's inward knowing. A live alternative is that 50:33 only identifies a later human class and does not revise the earlier nearness.

changed_reading.before: Nearness functions only as unilateral exposure of private thought.
changed_reading.after: Nearness also opens an inward relational channel: secrecy cannot hide the self, but it can be the medium of reverence and return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links present inward cognition to later eschatological acoustics. It remains anchored by the focus's hidden-sound and nearness branches and the context's listening, near call, and alarming shout; render it only as a sequence and scale analogy, not as identity between whisper and shout.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The hidden sound of 'whispers' and the comparative 'nearer.'

activation_trace.role: Begins the scale with sound below ordinary audibility.
Introduces deliberate auditory reception.
Raises the signal into an announced call.
Repeats nearness for the place from which the call arrives.
Completes the scale as a public, alarming shout.

changed_reading.before: Nearness is a static comparison to anatomy.
changed_reading.after: Nearness also collapses acoustic latency: the discourse ranges from unvoiced inner murmur to near call and universally heard shout without any hidden interval from divine knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps irrigation onto circulation. It remains anchored by the bodily cord and life-vein while the context explicitly routes water into growth and revival; render it as a material analogy only, not as lexical derivation or a physiological claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The bodily cord and jugular life-vein used to measure nearness.

activation_trace.role: Supplies bodily vessels and connections as internal channels.
Fixes the channel as a vein carrying life through the neck.
Contributes routed water as a life-delivery medium.
Shows delivery issuing in caused growth.
Makes irrigated growth a mechanism for reviving dead earth.

changed_reading.before: The jugular is only a ruler for physical closeness.
changed_reading.after: It can also image the human as internally irrigated: divine nearness is prior to the channel by which life is delivered, as rain is prior to sprouting and revival.

strongest_changes: The repeated 'we know what...' construction links material loss into earth with inward self-whisper as two forms of invisible identity that remain retained.
The immediate whisper-to-reception-to-utterance sequence places divine knowledge before speech becomes externally recordable.
Death and the later life/death declaration turn the jugular from a distance marker into a biological boundary that does not bound nearness.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly converts a static omniscience statement into processes: loss and preservation, intention becoming speech, circulation ending in death, and hidden inwardness returning toward mercy.
remaining_uncertainties: The comparative nearness can support epistemic, causal, relational, and spatially imaged force without deciding among them.
The acoustic and irrigation models are cross-domain analogies and should not be rendered as lexical equivalences.
Reciprocity is contextually activated but not grammatically asserted inside 50:16 itself.
